title: Users
description: Invite people, set the role, department, manager and block. Deleting accounts stays in the Strapi admin (through the SSH tunnel).
tile: Set roles, departments and managers, block accounts.
selfHint: This is you. Only another admin can change your own role or block.
lockedHint: Comes from Microsoft Entra and is synced at every sign-in.
optionsFailed: The selection lists could not be loaded. Department and manager cannot be changed right now.

roleSource.entra: The role comes from Microsoft Entra.
roleSource.manual: The role is set by hand.

role.label: Role
role.hint: A role set by hand overrides Entra for this account.

blocked.label: Account blocked
blocked.hint: Blocked accounts are signed out at once and cannot sign in any more.

handBack.button: Hand the role back to Entra
handBack.title: Hand the role back to Entra?
handBack.body: At the next sign-in the account takes its role from Entra. Until then it keeps the current role.

oidc.lockedHint: Comes from the sign-in provider and is synced at every sign-in.
oidc.roleSource: The role comes from the sign-in provider.
oidc.roleHint: A role set by hand overrides the sign-in provider for this account. Without an intranet role in the sign-in provider the account still cannot sign in.

handBack.button: Hand the role back to the sign-in provider
handBack.title: Hand the role back to the sign-in provider?
handBack.body: At the next sign-in the account takes its role from the sign-in provider. Until then it keeps the current role.

teams.label: Teams
teams.hint: Members are managed on each team.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.description: Each person gets an e-mail with a link to set their password (valid for 7 days). The account exists right away; it can sign in once the password is set.
invite.linesHint: One person per line: an address, or an address and a name separated by a semicolon. Up to 100 lines.
invite.lineInvalid: Not a valid address (or listed twice)

outcome.mailFailed: Account created, but the mail failed: send the link again from the user's page
outcome.taken: This address already has an account
outcome.mailNotConfigured: E-mail is not set up on the server (SMTP)
outcome.emailDuplicates: Existing accounts share an address in different spelling; invitations are off until an admin resolves that

link.invitationBody: The person gets a new invitation mail (valid for 7 days). An earlier link stops working.
link.resetBody: The person gets a mail with a link to set a new password (valid for one hour). The current password keeps working until then.

error.notLocal: This account signs in through the identity provider and has no password here.
error.mailNotConfigured: E-mail is not set up on the server (SMTP).
error.mailFailed: The mail could not be sent. Please try again later.
error.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

mfaReset.title: Reset two-factor sign-in?
mfaReset.body: Use this when the person lost their device and their recovery codes. Their sessions end, and at the next sign-in they set up a new authenticator.
mfaReset.failed: The reset did not work. Please try again.
